The Senate Bill 127 By: Senators Bearden of Committee on Regulated Industries and Utilities offered the 30th, Brass of the 6th, Anavitarte of the 31st, Strickland of the 42nd, Albers of the 56th and others following substitute to SB 127: MOOT
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Title 13 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to contracts, so as to make certain disclosure and notification requirements concerning automatic renewal provisions applicable to service contracts with small businesses; to revise and provide for definitions; to provide for related matters; to provide for an effective date and applicability; to repeal conflicting laws; and for other purposes.
BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF GEORGIA:
SECTION 1. Title 13 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to contracts, is amended by revising Chapter 12, relating … "CHAPTER 12
13-12-1. As used in this chapter, the term: (1) 'Automatic renewal provision' means a provision under which a service contract is renewed for a specified period of more than one month if the renewal causes the service contract to be in effect more than six months after the day of the initiation of the service contract. Such renewal is effective unless the consumer or small business gives notice to the seller of the consumer's or small business's intention to terminate the service contract. (2) 'Consumer' means a natural person or a nonprofit organization exempt from … contract offer.
13-12-3. (a) Any seller that sells, leases, or offers to sell or lease any service to a consumer or small business pursuant to a service contract for a specified period of 12 months or more and that automatically renews for a specified period of more than one month, unless the consumer or small business cancels the contract, shall provide the consumer or small business with written or electronic notification of the automatic renewal provision. Notification shall be provided to the consumer or small business no less than 30 days or no … provided in Chapter 1 or 2 of Title 7 or any depository institution as defined in 12 U.S.C. Section 1813(c)(2); (2) A foreign bank maintaining a branch or agency licensed under the laws of any state of the United States; (3) Any subsidiary or affiliate of an entity provided in paragraph (1) or (2) of this Code section; (4) Any electric utility as provided in Chapter 3 of Title 46; (5) Any entity regulated pursuant to Chapter 45 of Title 43; or (6) Any county, municipal corporation, authority, or local government or governing body; or (7) Any service … services to be provided thereunder or the equivalent thereof for any other installment period provided in such service contract.
13-12-5. A violation of this chapter renders the automatic renewal provision of a contract void and unenforceable."
SECTION 2. This Act shall become effective on July 1, 2026, and shall apply to service contracts entered into on or after such date. SECTION 3. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
